title: Returns and Option Activity over the Option-Expiration Week for S&P 100 Stocks
summary: Individual-stock option evidence does not provide a ready ES/NQ strategy; full rules and stock/option inputs are absent.
about: Stock returns and option activity over the monthly expiry cycle.
findings: Authors describe stronger expiry-week returns and weaker following-week returns with differences by option activity.
mechanism: Market-maker stock hedges may unwind as calls expire; this is not established ES futures alpha.
build_on: No current TEST: stock/option panels are unowned and SSRN lists no downloadable paper. This is not an authenticated implementation of the JPM guide.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Not faithfully from owned futures OHLCV; an index-futures replacement would be a separate adaptation.
reading_scope: Indexed SSRN and publisher abstract/introduction only; no full paper.
source_version: Stivers and Sun; Journal of Banking & Finance37(11),4226–4240,2013; SSRN indexed last revision11October2016.
owned_input_mapping: Individual S&P100 stock/option open interest and opening/closing activity, not owned ES/NQ minute prices.
deeper_investigation: Park and move on, without a duplicate expiry-family trial.
